reason: The assistant proposed and attempted an item exchange on order #W1603792 despite the order being pending, not delivered. This violates the retail status rule for exchanges/returns, and it also attempted a second modification on an order already modified once, which the policy says cannot be modified again after item modification (and in context the pending-order modification flow is one-time). The last assistant message explicitly states it cannot complete the exchange, but the prohibited proposal/action already occurred in the visible prefix.
